questions.question: Against which people is the oracle in Jeremiah 47?
What image describes the coming army in Jeremiah 47?
options: A great swarm of locusts darkening the whole of the sky
A mighty whirlwind lifting up the dust of all the earth
Waters rising out of the north, an overflowing torrent
A raging fire sweeping across all of the dry open fields
questions.answer: Waters rising out of the north, an overflowing torrent

questions.question: Jeremiah 47 mentions the cities of Gaza and Ashkelon among the Philistines.
The oracle concerning the _____, before Pharaoh struck down Gaza.
Behold, _____ are rising out of the north and shall become an overflowing torrent.
